book.name: Matyu
book.title: MATYU Kamambuno wakai Matyu muno boglkwa

content: Yomba ta embriyeno ya mambunomo yumbu sikraglkwa
“Yomba ta erambere ene yumbu sikriyo, ene yegl etn, God ene yegl keunde eretenambuka.
Ene mambuno etnere yegl, God yegl keunde eretenambuka, te ene yomba ere tenaglkwa yeglmere God ama ene ere tenambuka.
“Sraglpre ene angitn ongumuglo mina endi surmane yongwa yendo dine? Enene ongumutn mina endi bange pond pangwa imbor yende ana okuwo angitn yendo ditenatnga.
Ene engenge ongumutn mina ende bange pond ta panan, ene sraglpre angitn ongumuglo mina taragl kembra yongwa, i yendinagle dine?
Ene kakimbi yomba, okuna kana endi bange enene ongumutn mina pangwa imenda ende ana okuwo ene kanpogl sindre ana angitn ongumuglo mina endi surmane yongwa i ere i-endinatnga.

“Taragl God teingo holi yongwa i ene indre agl tekriyo, te ene taragl wakai i-wan meglkwa i bugla tekriyo. Ene yegl erimbi, ye katno mina engre deruwagl baruwagl ere, okuwo ana kan ikine ende enene si ninaglkwa.”
Krapogl, doko, dua sigiu dinaglkwa
Yesus ka aglke yegl dungwa, “Krapotn ana God ene tenambuka, dokun ana ene kanatnga. Sigiu dimin ana yungu dra yauro ende tenambuka.
Yomba prapra God krapogltre, inaglkwa; te ye dokindre kanaglkwa. Te ye sigiu dimbi, yungu dra yauro ende tenambuka.
“Ene mina yagl suwarata wam kaiya wedi kra poran, ye kombuglo ta pra i-tenambo?
Mo ye fis ta kra poran ye toki ta i-tenambo? Tamanga.
Ene yomba kinde meglkwa ba, pirpogl sindre nangro taragl wakai i-teingwa, yeglmere Neno God heven moglkwa imbo, yana dinaglkwa ye taragl wakai mere tenambuka.
Ene engenge yomba taragl ere naraglmedi pitnere yeglmere ye eretenatnga, i we Moses lomo ya te propet wagle ye kanno i mambuno kaima pangwa.
Konbo dra kembra ya te kande
“Ene konbo dra kembra yomara i suna enaglkwa. Konbo dra kande yongwa i yei endpi guglo kamun ongwa, igle yomba merkinde eingwa.
Ba dra kembra yendre te konbo urur yomara i yombuglo ere, endpi kor-moraglkwa kamun ongwa, i yomba kurita doko kan ingwa.
Propet kakimbi yomba
“Ene kan kuno ere molo, propet kakimbi yomba unaglkwa. Ene ye kanimbi nangino tembe sipsip mereyegl ere unaglkwa, ba ye nomano suna i agl are mereyegl pangwa.

Yombamo i moglpai eraglkwa mambunono i ene kanaglkwa. Yomba ta pra pi endi kangigle ormara suna wain mongo kogl panan urambo? Te yomba ta kugl kinde panambara suna i ende kogla mongo kogl panan uraglmo mo? Kaima tamanga.
Yeglmere endi wakai pangwa i mongo wakai koglkwa, te endi kinde pangwa i mongo kinde koglkwa.
Endi wakai ta mongo kinde koglkrambuka, te endi kinde ta mongo wakai koglkrambuka.
Endi ta mongo wakai koglkrambuka, i boro ende ipi donga mina gagltenge eraglkwa.
Yeglmere ene propet kakimbi yomba ye mambunono i wu pene enan kanaglkwa.

“Ene yegl di pirkraglkwa, yomba na kangina dagl, Yaglkande, Yaglkande di moraglkwa, ba ye prapra heven enaglmedi ta pirkraglkwa, yomba ta Nina heven moglkwa imbo ye prumere mere sika sinambuka i ye heven kingdom enambuka.
Enge kande mina yomba merkinde yegl di naraglkwa, ‘Yaglkande, Yaglkande, no ene kangin mina kamambuno dikunedino? Te ene kangin mina spirit kinde sende kuno endino? Te kimagl kanekane erekunedino?’
Yegl dimbi okuwo na nongugl kaima yegl ditenaglka, ‘Na ene ta kanpogl sikrika. Ene ende eglke piyo, ene mambuno kinde kanekane erikwa yomba.
Yomba yungu wakai ya kinde keingwa mambuno
“Yeglpre yomba tau na kanna pirpogl sindre ana duglo boraglkwa, yombamo i eremogl yomba tau nomano pai pogl sungwa kombuglo bolamugl yungu kei paingwa yeglmere.
Ana kamun pond sungwa, nigl si, ir iwanga mange yungu mina sungwa. Ba yungu i kombuglo bolamugl keingwa pre ukandi yange sikrukwa.
Te yomba tau na kanna i pirtre ana ye sika sikraglkwa, ye yagl du orkwa ta eremogl yungumo okupo yomara bolamugl keingwa yeglmere.
Ana kamun pond sungwa, nigl si, ir yuwanga mange yungumo igle sungwa, bukondi yangesi bogl deruwagl ere kondungwa.”
Ana Yesus ka i dite kondungo, yomba merkinde makaisi meglkwa ye kamo i pir sipuglo dingwa.
I sraglpre, ye yombuglo gigledi kande pangwa pre ka giglendi beke tongwa, i lo beke teingwa yomba yeglmere manga.
